name: Draw Text
description: Write text on a picture: a line or a block (a new line breaks it, a Max width wraps it), at a position, with a color, an optional outline and a box behind it. The font is the built-in Noto Sans.

inputs.name: anchor
inputs.label: Anchor
inputs.description: Which point of the text block is put at X and Y.

inputs.name: x
inputs.label: X
inputs.description: Pixels from the left of the picture.

inputs.name: y
inputs.label: Y
inputs.description: Pixels from the top of the picture.

inputs.name: size
inputs.label: Size
inputs.description: The height of a line in pixels.

inputs.name: max_width
inputs.label: Max width
inputs.description: Wrap a line at this many pixels. 0 does not wrap.

inputs.name: align
inputs.label: Align
inputs.description: How the lines of a block sit against each other.

inputs.name: outline
inputs.label: Outline
inputs.description: Pixels of outline around every letter. 0 is none.

inputs.name: box
inputs.label: Box
inputs.description: Draw a box behind the text.
